name: section-shell
title: Section shell
description: A titled page section: heading, description, actions and content in one landmark, with the spacing and anchor already right.
docs: title names the section and the section is labelled by it, so it shows up in a screen reader's list of landmarks; level is h2 to h4. description sits under the title and actions on its line, where they wrap beneath it on a phone. tone is plain (a hairline under the header), bordered (a card with a ruled header and footer) or muted (a soft panel). footer is a row under the content, and empty is what to show when there are no children, so a section never shows a lonely heading. id makes the section a link target, with a scroll margin of --section-scroll-offset (5rem) so a sticky header never covers its heading. Stacked sections keep a gap of --section-shell-gap (2rem) between them, with no margin at the call site.
